product_overview: Naura Hoshino V2 is an all-in-one Discord application with a cyberpunk anime companion persona, RPG survival systems, music streaming, and a web dashboard for server administration and live monitoring. The backend API supports health diagnostics, public rankings, authenticated user preferences, guild automation management, and secure donation webhooks.
core_goals: Provide reliable system health and diagnostics for bot and infrastructure monitoring
Expose public leaderboard and statistics data for community engagement
Support authenticated user session retrieval and language preference management
Enable guild administrators to view settings and configure automations
Accept secure, idempotent donation webhooks for external reward integrations

features.name: Health & System Diagnostics API
features.description: Allows operators and dashboard users to check service status, bot performance, database connectivity, and overall statistics.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with uptime, memory, shard, database, and Lavalink connectivity details -> Display system health in the dashboard
GET /api/stats -> Receive 200 with total users, guilds, and RAM usage -> Render overview cards on the dashboard
GET /api/health with an unavailable dependency -> Receive 200 with one or more service states indicating degraded connectivity -> Show partial outage status to operators

features.name: Public Leaderboard & Economy API
features.description: Provides read-only ranked community data for wealth, level progression, and related leaderboard categories.
user_flows: GET /api/leaderboard?type=wealth&limit=10 -> Receive 200 with a ranked list of top users including avatars and net worth -> Display the wealth leaderboard
GET /api/leaderboard?type=trivia&limit=50 -> Receive 200 with up to 50 ranked players -> Show trivia rankings in descending order
GET /api/leaderboard?type=unknown&limit=10 -> Receive 500 with an error payload -> Show a leaderboard loading error message

features.name: User Profile & Session API
features.description: Lets authenticated users view their Discord session profile and update their dashboard language preference.
user_flows: GET /api/user/@me with a valid auth token -> Receive 200 with the authenticated Discord user profile and session data -> Populate the user account page
POST /api/user/language with {"language":"id"} and a valid auth token -> Receive 200 confirming the language update -> Refresh the interface in Indonesian
GET /api/user/@me without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Prompt the user to log in
POST /api/user/language with {"language":"fr"} and a valid auth token -> Receive 400 invalid language response -> Keep the current language unchanged

features.name: Guild Management & Automations API
features.description: Enables guild administrators to retrieve server configuration and create or update automation workflows for their Discord server.
user_flows: GET /api/guild/123456789/settings with a valid auth token and guild access -> Receive 200 with server settings, welcomer configuration, softban channels, and AI persona data -> Render the guild settings page
POST /api/guild/123456789/automations with valid workflow data -> Receive 200 confirming the automation save -> Activate the updated server automation rules
GET /api/guild/123456789/settings without permission to the guild -> Receive 403 forbidden response -> Deny access to the guild configuration page
POST /api/guild/123456789/automations with malformed event conditions -> Receive 400 invalid request response -> Keep the previous automation configuration

features.name: Webhook Integration API
features.description: Receives secure donation webhooks from external platforms and processes rewards idempotently using transaction keys.
user_flows: POST /api/webhook/saweria with a valid Authorization header and new transaction key -> Receive 200 acknowledging the webhook -> Credit donation rewards exactly once
POST /api/webhook/trakteer with a valid Authorization header and new transaction key -> Receive 200 acknowledging the webhook -> Process vote or donation rewards for the user
POST /api/webhook/saweria with an invalid Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Reject the webhook without processing rewards
POST /api/webhook/trakteer with a previously processed transaction key -> Receive 200 acknowledging the webhook -> Skip duplicate reward processing to preserve idempotency
